title: 团宠小河马与冻成冰块的青蛙
pdf: https://michael-podcast-1513696684.cos.ap-chengdu.myqcloud.com/vol20/Vol20_晚读讲义_团宠小河马与冻成冰块的青蛙_v2.pdf

blocks.en: Hello, young explorers, and welcome back to Michael's Morning Listening! This is our twentieth show together! Today we meet a baby hippo who became a superstar, and a frog that turns into ice every winter — and wakes up in spring! Two animals, two superpowers. One loves the camera. One loves the cold. Let's go!
blocks.title: 开场白
blocks.cn: 你好，小小探险家们，欢迎回到 Michael 的早听晚读！这是我们在一起的第二十期节目啦！今天我们要认识一只成了大明星的河马宝宝，还有一只每年冬天都把自己冻成冰、春天又醒过来的青蛙！两只动物，两种超能力。一个爱镜头，一个爱严寒。出发吧！

blocks.en: Say hello to Moo Deng, a pygmy hippo at Khao Kheow Open Zoo in Thailand. She is much smaller than her big cousins, and rounder than a beach ball. Her name means "bouncy pork" in Thai, and fans chose it in a vote. She comes from a pork dynasty: Mother Jona, Father Tony, and all her brothers and sisters carry porky names.
blocks.title: 团宠小河马
blocks.cn: 来认识一下弹跳猪（Moo Deng）吧，它是泰国绿山野生动物园里的一只倭河马。它比它的大个子亲戚们小得多，圆得像个沙滩球。它的名字在泰语里意思是“弹跳的猪肉”，是粉丝们投票选出来的。它出身于一个“猪肉世家”：妈妈 Jona、爸爸 Tony，还有它的哥哥姐姐们，个个都带着和猪肉有关的名字。

blocks.en: Her keeper, Atthapon, began posting videos of her on social media — splashing in her pool, opening her mouth wide, taking awkward little steps. The videos went viral worldwide. Soon everyone seemed astonished: how could one small hippo hold so much appeal?
blocks.title: 团宠小河马
blocks.cn: 它的饲养员 Atthapon 开始把它的短视频发到社交媒体上——它在水池里扑腾，张大嘴巴，迈着笨拙的小步子。这些视频在全世界疯传。很快，所有人都惊讶不已：一只小小的河马，怎么会有这么大的吸引力？

blocks.en: When she yawned or bounced across her pen, crowds erupted with laughter. Fans travelled far to see her, and zoo visitor numbers jumped to three times their old size. The zoo set up a live camera service, so fans on far continents could watch her splash and sleep.
blocks.title: 团宠小河马
blocks.cn: 当它打哈欠、或者在围栏里蹦来蹦去时，人群会爆发出一阵大笑。粉丝们从很远的地方赶来看它，动物园的游客量涨到了原来的三倍。动物园还开设了实时摄像服务，让远在其他大陆的粉丝也能看着它玩水和睡觉。

blocks.en: She got her own song, appeared in a comedy show, and even picked the winner of an election by choosing between two cakes! Best of all, her fame helps every pygmy hippo, an endangered species that needs protection.
blocks.title: 团宠小河马
blocks.cn: 它有了自己的专属歌曲，上过喜剧节目，甚至在两块蛋糕之间做选择，挑中了一场选举的赢家！最棒的是，它的走红帮助了所有的倭河马——这是一个需要保护的濒危物种。

blocks.en: Now meet the wood frog of Alaska, the northernmost frog in the world. Most frogs hibernate deep under the ground. This one does not. When the cold comes, it climbs under dead leaves — and lets itself freeze.
blocks.title: 冻成冰块的青蛙
blocks.cn: 现在来认识一下阿拉斯加的木蛙，它是世界上分布最靠北的青蛙。大多数青蛙会在地底深处冬眠。这一只不会。寒冷到来时，它爬到枯叶下面——让自己冻起来。

blocks.en: Ice grows inside its body, between its skin and muscles, and even inside its eyes. Soon almost seventy percent of the water in its body is ice. Its blood freezes, its breathing stops, and its heart stops beating. To any eye, the frog looks quite dead.
blocks.title: 冻成冰块的青蛙
blocks.cn: 冰在它体内生长，在皮肤和肌肉之间，甚至钻进它的眼睛里。很快，它体内将近百分之七十的水都变成了冰。它的血液冻住了，呼吸停止了，心脏也不跳了。在任何人眼里，这只青蛙都已经死透了。

blocks.en: But the frog has a sweet secret. Before the freeze, its liver fills its cells with glucose — a sugar that works like antifreeze. The sugar protects each cell from damage, so no ice can grow inside them. Frozen solid for months, the wood frog does not breathe or move, yet when spring warms the pond, its heart starts again, as if nothing had happened.
blocks.title: 冻成冰块的青蛙
blocks.cn: 但是这只青蛙藏着一个甜蜜的秘密。在结冰之前，它的肝脏会把葡萄糖灌满它的细胞——这种糖的作用就像防冻剂。糖保护每个细胞不受损伤，所以冰不会在细胞里面生长。木蛙冻得硬邦邦的，好几个月不呼吸、不动弹，可是当春水暖起来时，它的心脏又跳了起来，仿佛什么都没发生过。

blocks.en: And this trick has real significance for us. Scientists hope it may one day help doctors keep donated organs alive for longer. All that from one small frog, sleeping under the leaves!
blocks.title: 冻成冰块的青蛙
blocks.cn: 而且，这个本领对我们人类也有真正的意义。科学家们希望，有一天它能帮助医生让捐赠的器官存活更久。这一切，都来自一只睡在落叶下的小青蛙！

blocks.en: Here's today's idiom: "a blessing in disguise." A blessing is a lucky thing. A disguise is a costume that hides you. So a blessing in disguise is a good thing hiding inside a bad thing. Listen to this: Max hated his haircut — the barber shaved it too short, and he hid under a hat. But at swimming class, with almost no hair, Max swam faster than ever — and won his race! The terrible haircut was a blessing in disguise.
blocks.title: 今日俚语
blocks.cn: 今天的俚语是“a blessing in disguise”（藏在伪装里的祝福）。blessing 是一件幸运的好事；disguise 是把你藏起来的伪装服装。所以 a blessing in disguise 就是一件藏在坏事里面的好事。听这个小故事：Max 讨厌他的发型——理发师把他的头发剪得太短了，他只好戴着帽子把自己藏起来。可是在游泳课上，头发几乎没有了，Max 游得比以往都快——还赢得了比赛！那个糟糕的发型，原来是一份伪装起来的祝福。

blocks.en: Let's think about our stories. A baby hippo became a star, and a frozen frog woke up to spring. Two questions for you. First: if your pet became world-famous on social media, what would it be famous for? Second: the wood frog sleeps through winter. If you could sleep through one whole season, which would you choose? Talk about it with your family!
blocks.title: 结束语与互动问题
blocks.cn: 我们来想想今天的故事。一只河马宝宝成了明星，一只冻僵的青蛙迎来了春天。轮到回答两个问题。第一：如果你的宠物在社交媒体上红遍全世界，它会因为什么出名？第二：木蛙会睡过整个冬天。如果你能睡过一整个季节，你会选哪一个？和家人聊聊吧！

blocks.en: That's all for today, young explorers. Remember: a bad haircut, a ruined plan — sometimes they are blessings in disguise. Stay curious, and keep exploring. See you tomorrow morning!
blocks.title: 告别
blocks.cn: 今天的节目就到这里，小小探险家们。记住：一个糟糕的发型、一个被打乱的计划——它们有时候就是伪装起来的祝福。保持好奇心，继续探索吧。明天早上见！

quiz.title: B. 单项选择（Single Choice）
questions:
How did Moo Deng get her name?
A. Her keeper named her after his mother
B. Fans chose it in a vote
C. She was named after a famous song
D. The zoo director picked it from a book

What happened after the keeper posted her videos on social media?
A. The zoo closed for a month
B. Visitor numbers fell
C. Visitor numbers jumped to three times their old size
D. She moved to another zoo

What happens to the wood frog in winter?
A. It digs a deep hole and sleeps
B. Its body freezes and its heart stops beating
C. It swims under the ice
D. It travels south to warm forests

What does "a blessing in disguise" mean?
A. A gift wrapped in pretty paper
B. A costume for a party
C. A good thing hiding inside a bad thing
D. A blessing you must hide from friends

when spring warms the pond, its heart starts again,
：它省略了主语和 be 动词，完整意思是
(After it is) frozen solid for months
（被冻得硬邦邦的，达数月之久）。分词短语的逻辑主语必须和主句主语是同一个——这里都是
，所以可以放心省略。读到句首的分词短语，先在心里把它补全。
the wood frog does not breathe or move
连接（否定句中并列成分用 or，不用 and），意思是"既不呼吸，也不动弹"。
（可是、然而）：前面说青蛙冻得像死了，后面却说春天一来心脏又跳了——
一出场，就预告"反转来了"。
，表示"仿佛（在那之前）什么都没发生过"——其实明明冻了几个月，
+ 过去完成时把这种"装作没事"的语气拉满。
冻了数月（分词短语交代状态）→ 不呼吸不动弹（主干）→ 然而春天一暖，心脏重启（yet 引出反转）→ 仿佛什么都没发生过（as if 收尾点睛）
。一句话讲完一只青蛙的"假死与重生"。
"means 'bouncy pork' in Thai, and fans chose it in a vote."
"zoo visitor numbers jumped to three times their old size."
"Its blood freezes, its breathing stops, and its heart stops beating."

words.clue: News, videos and photos shared online. Example: Social ___ is where her keeper posted the videos.
A sweet sugar the frog's liver makes; it works like antifreeze in its cells. Example: "Its liver fills its cells with ___."
Clumsy and funny to watch. Example: The baby hippo takes ___ little steps.
Spread all over the internet very fast. Example: Her videos went ___.
Turned into ice. Example: The frog stays ___ solid for months.
A family line that keeps the same name or job. Example: Moo Deng comes from a pork ___ of hippos.
To burst out suddenly. Example: The crowds ___ed with laughter. (past form in the text)
A big round water animal; Moo Deng is a pygmy one. Example: Moo Deng is a baby ___ from Thailand.
The charm that makes people love something. Example: One small hippo holds so much ___.
To sleep through the whole winter, the way the wood frog does. Example: Most frogs ___ deep under the ground.
